race.comment: BEACH MAGIC (6) brings the most reliable profile in a thin NR up to 38 contest. His last-start seventh at Redcliffe reads plainly, but he was beaten only six and a half metres in a NR 38 to 45 and had placed the run prior, while his broader recent and distance ratings are the strongest in the race. ICANANDIWILL (3) has the front-row draw and the fast 1:55.5 mile-rate race behind her here last week, though the rise from 1660m to 2138m is the key query. ROSIE POLLEN (7) was behind ICANANDIWILL in that same race, yet her previous second here keeps her right in the chances. OUR DOLLY (2) will be fitter for recent racing and draws well so can improve.
